import cyclopts
from cyclopts.types import ExistingFilePath

app = cyclopts.App()

@app.command
def convert(input_file: ExistingFilePath, output_name: str):
    """Convert an existing file."""
    content = input_file.read_text()
    output_file = input_file.parent / output_name
    output_file.write_text(content)
    print(f"Converted {input_file} to {output_file}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
